structural_review.notes: Triangle mode, valid GLB length, UVs and embedded 1024px base colour checked. Requested targets are approximate; actual triangle count and target deviations are reported separately, within the user-specified 3000-prop / 8000-character ceilings. Scale, pivot, topology and visual quality require separate review.

visual_review.notes: Follow-up roof-integrity review after native suburbia capture: existing tile and ridge joins had tiny openings to light underlying surfaces. Added 24 triangles as two continuous closed inset roof underlays using existing matching painted atlas; preserved every original tile, wall and texture pixel. Rechecked actual GLB overhead, underside and three-quarter views; underlays seated below roof and within eaves, silhouette retained. The large cream L-shaped patch on teal is baked albedo on an intact tile, confirmed by unlit overhead and wireframe face coverage; deliberately preserved. Door facade +Z, height3.5m, uniform grounded import unchanged. Authoring import QA only; native capture should be regenerated with this current model hash.

import_review.notes: Real scene vertices and indices decoded; finite positions/UVs; retained embedded 1024px base colour. Uniform root transform; raw file preserved.

geometry_repair.description: Added two thin continuous closed roof underlays behind existing healthy tile and ridge joins. Original tile/body geometry and original embedded paint atlas retained unchanged.

details.large_teal_light_patch: Existing baked albedo on intact tile, confirmed by unlit and wireframe overhead review; preserved.

geometry_repair.material_policy: Original embedded base-colour and material retained; no PBR maps, no retexture.
